name: dithering-hover
title: Dithering Hover
description: Any image turns into a black-and-white Bayer dither under the cursor. The dithered zone follows the pointer with a ragged rim and radial streaks that break up and fade, rendered live on a canvas. Controls for zone size, dot size, matrix, inks, roughness and an inverted mode. Exports drawDither for static renders.
